products.name: Desktop Humidifier Cooler
products.description:
Meet the 3-in-1 Desktop Humidifier Cooler from ShereboyTech—your perfect cooling companion for home or the office!

💨 It doesn't just blow air like a regular fan. It cools, humidifies, and refreshes your room with a cool mist for a more comfortable environment.

✨ Here's why you'll love it:

❄️ Instant cooling mist for hot days.
🌬️ 3 adjustable fan speeds—Low, Medium, and High.
💡 Beautiful 7-color LED night light for a relaxing atmosphere.
💧 Large 600ml water tank for hours of continuous cooling.
🤫 Ultra-quiet operation, perfect for sleeping or studying.
🔌 USB powered, so you can use it with a laptop, power bank, or USB adapter.

Whether you're working, relaxing, gaming, or sleeping, this mini air cooler keeps you cool and comfortable wherever you are.
